description.value: Red Swan Pizza is a franchise pizza outlet located in a strip-mall unit on North Parallel Road in Abbotsford's Whatcom area, next to Pacific North Wellness. It specializes in fresh-made pizza available for takeout or delivery. Touring cyclists in the area can pick up a hot meal without a sit-down commitment.
